Do not merge closely in front of a truck or bus and then reduce speed. Before moving into the lane ahead of a truck or bus, make sure its entire front is visible in your rearview mirror. Give a commercial vehicle ample space during highway entry and merging, and avoid cutting it off, tailgating or speeding around it.
